overview: The Vanguard Fortification Line is the Umbral Vanguard’s primary defensive barrier against planar instability and Akhevan expansion in the Umbral Plains.
history: The Line was established after the first major planar fracture threatened to overwhelm the Plains.
Stabilizer pylons were erected to anchor void resonance and prevent collapse.
Akhevan Dominion forces repeatedly assaulted the Line with ritual constructs.
Shadow anomalies and voidborn entities forced the Vanguard to adapt their tactics and fortifications.
hooks: A stabilizer pylon begins to fail under void pressure.
Akhevan ritualists launch a coordinated assault on the Line.
Shadow anomalies breach the trenches, corrupting Vanguard troops.
Voidborn entities swarm from the nearby resonance basin.
